verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's first-party docs describe Incident Workflows as an automated response engine with configurable triggers and actions applying "if-this-then-that" logic, for example a workflow that auto-triggers for all P1 and P2 incidents. Documented actions include sending a webhook POST and adding the Scribe Agent, and Event Orchestration adds rule-based handling of incoming events. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the specific toil actions named in the story (status or stakeholder updates, scheduled reminders, incident field changes) and independent or hands-on corroboration of the workflow engine.
